summary: Plan and oversee digital cash and voucher transfers, agent readiness, liquidity, inclusion, and controls. Explore the course and request details.
lede: Digital cash and voucher delivery training helps programme, cash, social-protection, and finance teams oversee electronic transfers. Participants compare delivery mechanisms, assess agent-network and liquidity readiness, and plan controls, inclusion measures, monitoring, and continuity. Practical exercises produce delivery maps, decision matrices, and operational plans for programme choices and partner discussions; advanced provider assurance and payment architecture receive introductory coverage.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who specify, fund, operate, or oversee digital cash and voucher transfers. It is designed for practitioners who need to coordinate programme choices with finance, operations, payment partners, and affected communities.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with humanitarian or social-protection programme delivery is recommended. No coding or payment-platform configuration is required.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
